name: Corfu Old Town
description: The historic Kerkyra Old Town is a UNESCO site of narrow Venetian lanes, two fortresses and the Liston arcade. It is the island's most atmospheric base, packed with tavernas, cafes and shops, and everything is reachable on foot.
bestFor: Travellers wanting culture, cafes and walkable town life year-round

name: Kanoni
description: A residential peninsula just south of town famous for its view of Mouse Island and Vlacherna Monastery. It is quiet and green with sea views, close to the airport, and a manageable walk or short bus ride into the Old Town.
bestFor: Quiet stays with sea views but easy town and airport access

name: Kontokali
description: A coastal village about six kilometres north with a large marina, small beaches and a strip of tavernas and cafes. It offers a relaxed seaside base with good bus links to Corfu Town and is popular with longer-stay visitors.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting seaside calm with regular buses to town

name: Garitsa Bay
description: A residential seafront district curving along Garitsa Bay just south of the Old Town. It has a long promenade, local tavernas and quieter streets, giving a more everyday Corfu feel while staying within walking distance of the centre.
bestFor: Those wanting a walkable, local seafront base next to the centre
